src='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    a,b=q
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and q not in seen and grid[a][b]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            comps.append((color,pts))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,pts in comps:
        shift=h-1-max(r for r,c in pts)
        for r,c in pts: out[r+shift][c]=color
    return out
'''
